title: Grav API plugin from 1.0.0 before 1.1.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers with…
description: The Grav API plugin versions from 1.0.0 up to but not including 1.1.4 contain a remote code execution vulnerability. This flaw allows users with media and page write permissions to upload files to a theme's Twig templates folder via the blueprint-upload endpoint. By including the uploaded file in sandboxed page Twig templates, an attacker can execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the web-server user.
